\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\small
\item \textit{Notes:} Six projects in the estimation sample were discontinued after IPCEI approval; the firms are retained in the sample (see the Data section of the main text). \textit{Withdrawal} denotes voluntary exit from the scheme before project execution (Tesla withdrew from \texteuro{}1.14 billion in German IPCEI funding and built a privately funded battery plant). \textit{Insolvency} denotes bankruptcy or judicial liquidation of the firm or its project subsidiary (Northvolt filed for bankruptcy after exhausting \$15 billion in funding; McPhy entered judicial liquidation, with assets sold to John Cockerill Hydrogen; Fusion Fuel's Portuguese subsidiary became insolvent after a \texteuro{}33.5 million investor funding default). \textit{Discontinuation} denotes termination of the IPCEI-funded activity while the firm remains operational (Bosch ended its solid-oxide fuel-cell industrialisation and redeployed 550 staff to electrolyser activities; Alstom suspended its project after the French government cut national co-financing). Approval dates are the Commission's state aid decisions for the relevant technology; end dates are the earliest verifiable public announcement.
\end{tablenotes}
